title: [RIDGELINE] Talking While Walking the Camino Francés in Spain
content:
Ridgeline subscribers —
Heeeeeeellllloooooooo to the many many many many new subscribers who came from the Tim Pod(s). Welcome.
I’m Craig, and this is Ridgeline (my newsletter focused on walking (Roden, the other newsletter is more general)), which is supposed to be a weekly thing, but … wow, am I ever bowled under with to-dos in preparation for the launch of my book Things Become Other Things. We are a mere THREE WEEKS!
